risk_summary: A retry can capture the same order twice because the worker generates a fresh provider idempotency key on every attempt and records completion only after the external charge.

missing_controls: provider idempotency key reuse across retries
safe handling for timeout after provider success

expected_findings.reason: The idempotency key is random per attempt instead of bound to tenant, order, action, amount, and currency.
No durable duplicate ledger prevents concurrent or replayed captures.
The external charge occurs before local committed state can suppress a retry.
